xBRIEFInfo.description: Scope xBRIEF ingested from GitHub issue #4162

plan.title: [framework-gap] doctor checks consumer xbrief under the deposit root and emits an impossible warning

narratives.Description: Doctor's consumer framework-layout check looks for xbrief under the deposit while a current consumer keeps lifecycle at project-root xbrief and the shipped schema pack at deposit vbrief. The bound recut splits those identities, aligns migrate-preflight to vbrief/schemas, contains AGENTS.md install-root before echoing paths, and uses published-flatten fixtures.
narratives.Overview: Doctor looks for consumer xbrief under the deposit. Real lifecycle is project-root xbrief/; shipped pack is vbrief. Bound successor lean 5620897287: split identities, align migrate-preflight to vbrief/schemas, contain AGENTS.md install-root, use published-flatten fixtures. Issue thread is history; plan.items are the contract.
narratives.UserStory: As a consumer operator, I want Doctor and migrate-preflight to distinguish project lifecycle xbrief from the deposited vbrief schema pack, so that a healthy current consumer is not warned for a directory the flatten never creates.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: Follow successor lean 5620897287 Bound remedy. Split Doctor layout rows by identity (project lifecycle, contentRoot vbrief/schemas, engine dirs on deposit/framework root). Use resolved framework/content root for deposit/content rows. Align migrate-preflight schema FAIL to vbrief/schemas via shared contentRoot. Add contained install-root before path echo. Replace fake .deft/core/xbrief fixtures with the published flatten. Record CHANGELOG Unreleased.
narratives.AcceptanceJustification: Nine independently testable Bound-remedy clauses harvested from successor lean 5620897287 Recut list; collapsing them would drop a required identity split.

items.title: Do not bind a one-row retarget of consumer `framework-layout`'s `xbrief` slot onto project-root `xbrief/` as the whole design.

narrative.Acceptance: Given a packed consumer with project-root xbrief/ plus deposit vbrief/ and no .deft/core/xbrief/, when doctor --full --json runs, then it emits no missing-xbrief framework-layout warning.

items.title: Keep the postcondition: a healthy current consumer with project-root `xbrief/` plus deposit `vbrief/` and no `.deft/core/xbrief/` must not warn missing `xbrief/`.

narrative.Acceptance: Given the same healthy consumer, when a one-row project-root swap is proposed as the whole fix, then the shipped change rejects that as the complete design and records the split identities.

items.title: Split Doctor layout into distinct identities: project lifecycle at project-root `xbrief/` via existing `resolveLifecycleLayout` / envelope-version; framework schema pack at `contentRoot` as `vbrief/schemas`; engine dirs (`tasks`, source `scripts`) on deposit/framework root.

narrative.Acceptance: Given DEFT_ROOT or a content-package framework root, when Doctor layout-checks deposit/content rows, then those rows use the resolved framework/content root and do not discard it for an AGENTS.md depositRoot.

items.title: Consumer deposit/content rows must use the resolved framework/content root, not a re-derived AGENTS.md `depositRoot` that discards that root (DEFT_ROOT / content-package cases).

narrative.Acceptance: Given a source or flattened tree whose pack is vbrief/schemas, when migrate-preflight checkLayout runs, then it fails or passes against contentRoot vbrief/schemas and does not require project-root xbrief/schemas as the framework pack.

items.title: Align `migrate:preflight` schema FAIL to the real pack name `vbrief/schemas` through shared `contentRoot()`. Do not move that FAIL onto project-root `xbrief/schemas`. Preflight already checks project-root `xbrief/` separately.

narrative.Acceptance: Given an AGENTS.md install-root with .. or an absolute path, when Doctor prints a resolved layout path, then it rejects or contains that root (or falls back to .deft/core) and does not emit a host path outside the project.

items.title: If project-lifecycle absence remains in Doctor, report it under a project-lifecycle identity with the resolved project path. Do not treat `isDirectory(projectRoot/xbrief)` as complete health; cover valid, empty/greenfield, partial, legacy-only, and absent states without turning absence into an uncaught throw.

narrative.Acceptance: Given a packed-consumer fixture, when tests assert framework-layout, then the fixture uses project-root xbrief/ plus deposit vbrief/ and does not mkdir .deft/core/xbrief as the healthy shape.

items.title: Human and JSON output must identify which tree a missing path belongs to (project-lifecycle vs framework-content vs engine/deposit). Before probing or printing an AGENTS.md install-root, apply existing deposit containment (reject `..`, absolute, escaping symlinks) or fall back to `.deft/core`.

narrative.Acceptance: Given missing or partial project lifecycle, when Doctor reports it, then the finding returns a project-lifecycle identity with the resolved project path and does not treat a bare isDirectory as complete health.

items.title: Packed-consumer and installed-package fixtures must use the published flatten (lifecycle at project root, `vbrief` under the deposit). Do not mkdir `.deft/core/xbrief` as the healthy shape. Add first row-level `framework-layout` coverage for consumer and source-checkout branches. Move the #3372 fixture's deposit `xbrief` to the project root.

narrative.Acceptance: Given missing framework vbrief/schemas, when Doctor or migrate-preflight reports it, then the finding returns a framework-content identity with the selected content path.

items.title: Source-checkout coverage is re-derived from the same project/deposit split (roots coincide here), not a freeze of today's `EXPECTED_FRAMEWORK_DIRS` behavior.

narrative.Acceptance: Given source-checkout layout, when framework-layout coverage runs, then it is re-derived from the same project/deposit split and records CHANGELOG Unreleased.
